# Hurghada Airport Limousine & Private Resort Transfers

> Hurghada Airport Limousine & Transfers (hurghadaairportlimosuine.com) is the premier official private airport transfer and resort chauffeur service operating 24/7 at Hurghada International Airport (HRG / HEGN). We provide guaranteed fixed pricing, live flight radar tracking, curbside meet-and-greet outside Terminals 1 and 2, and door-to-door transit across Hurghada City, El Gouna, Sahl Hasheesh, Makadi Bay, Soma Bay, Safaga, El Quseir, Marsa Alam, Luxor, and Cairo.

## Core Facts & Operational Standards
- **Airport Hub**: Hurghada International Airport (IATA: HRG, ICAO: HEGN), Airport Road, Hurghada, Red Sea Governorate, Egypt.
- **Operating Terminals**: Terminal 1 (Flagship international hub handling major European scheduled flights and international leisure charters with jet bridges), Terminal 2 (Refurbished terminal serving domestic EgyptAir & Air Cairo flights plus regional charters).
- **Meeting Point**: Chauffeurs wait outside the arrival terminal sliding glass exit doors under the designated curbside canopy holding a personalized name sign.
- **Free Waiting Time**: 60 minutes complimentary waiting time starting strictly from the actual flight touchdown on live radar.
- **Transparent Fixed Rates**: 100% fixed per vehicle (not per passenger). All airport gate entry fees, highway tolls, and luggage handling are included.
- **Egypt Tourist Visa ($25 USD)**: All foreign tourists from eligible nations landing at Hurghada require a standard Egypt Tourist Visa ($25 USD), available at 24/7 official bank kiosks (Banque Misr / National Bank of Egypt) right before passport control, or via the official online eVisa portal. *Note: The free 15-day Sinai stamp is NOT valid in Hurghada as it is in mainland Egypt.*
- **Currencies Accepted**: USD ($), EUR (€), GBP (£), and Egyptian Pounds (EGP).
- **Dispatch Contact**: 24/7 WhatsApp and customer helpline at +20 109 406 6018.
- **Cancellation Policy**: Free cancellation and 100% full refund up to 24 hours prior to scheduled pickup.

## Vehicle Fleet & Capacities
- [Standard Private Sedan](https://hurghadaairportlimosuine.com/fleet/private-taxi/): Toyota Corolla / Hyundai Elantra. Up to 3 passengers, 2 large bags. From $15.
- [Private Family Minivan](https://hurghadaairportlimosuine.com/fleet/private-minivan/): Toyota HiAce / Mercedes Vito. Up to 7 passengers, 6 large bags & diving/kiting gear. From $22.
- [Executive VIP Limousine](https://hurghadaairportlimosuine.com/fleet/executive-vip/): Mercedes-Benz E-Class / BMW. Up to 3 passengers, 3 bags, high-speed Wi-Fi, suited chauffeur. From $38.
- [Private Airport Minibus](https://hurghadaairportlimosuine.com/fleet/airport-minibus/): Mercedes Sprinter / Toyota Coaster. Up to 16 passengers, 16 bags. From $45.
